psychological_meaning: Eden, a dark teal color, evokes feelings of tranquility, sophistication, and depth. It represents a harmonious blend of growth and stability, reminiscent of lush forests and serene waters. This color promotes a sense of calm confidence and can inspire creativity while grounding the mind.
